Name: Bufflehead ducks
Author: Esodra
Description:
I felt like there wasn't enough versions for the ducks, and I wanted something diffirent, I have always liked the design of the Bufflehead ducks, the females at least, so I chose to make one for them :D

In order to apply, simply drag the file to Stardew Valley > Content > Animals, when asked if you want to replace simply say yes and you got your new ducks!

Also, this is my first mod, so I'm very sorry if something is off.
